# Reproduce the headline champion odds (Argentina ~31%) for the 2026 World Cup.
# Self-contained Elo -> Poisson -> Monte-Carlo, everything inlined. Runs in-browser via Pyodide.
# Reduced N=10,000 (the published figure uses N=100,000); result is within Monte-Carlo noise.
import math
import numpy as np

# ---- inlined model inputs (extracted verbatim from the vetted model's DATA, Elo cutoff 2026-06-24) ----
ELO = {"Czech Republic":1768.4,"Mexico":2003.3,"South Africa":1666.5,"South Korea":1888.6,"Bosnia & Herzegovina":1654.9,"Canada":1888.7,"Qatar":1578.8,"Switzerland":1951.2,"Brazil":2072.9,"Haiti":1677.7,"Morocco":2011.8,"Scotland":1843.6,"Australia":1913.6,"Paraguay":1901.5,"Turkey":1881.6,"USA":1920.3,"Curaçao":1618.4,"Ecuador":1957.5,"Germany":2033.7,"Ivory Coast":1844.3,"Japan":2011.8,"Netherlands":2037.8,"Sweden":1793.1,"Tunisia":1671.3,"Belgium":1940.1,"Egypt":1858.2,"Iran":1894.2,"New Zealand":1710.5,"Cape Verde":1701.8,"Saudi Arabia":1706.3,"Spain":2197.9,"Uruguay":1935.8,"France":2153.7,"Iraq":1708.0,"Norway":2014.8,"Senegal":1871.9,"Algeria":1889.3,"Argentina":2220.1,"Austria":1905.9,"Jordan":1724.8,"Colombia":2091.3,"DR Congo":1775.0,"Portugal":2052.6,"Uzbekistan":1779.9,"Croatia":1939.5,"England":2120.6,"Ghana":1673.2,"Panama":1807.0}
PARAMS = {"a":0.04219960215859936,"b":0.00517897717158734,"mu":2.739846463953339}  # Poisson calibration: supremacy = a + b*dElo, total goals = mu
GROUPS = {"A":["Czech Republic","Mexico","South Africa","South Korea"],"B":["Bosnia & Herzegovina","Canada","Qatar","Switzerland"],"C":["Brazil","Haiti","Morocco","Scotland"],"D":["Australia","Paraguay","Turkey","USA"],"E":["Curaçao","Ecuador","Germany","Ivory Coast"],"F":["Japan","Netherlands","Sweden","Tunisia"],"G":["Belgium","Egypt","Iran","New Zealand"],"H":["Cape Verde","Saudi Arabia","Spain","Uruguay"],"I":["France","Iraq","Norway","Senegal"],"J":["Algeria","Argentina","Austria","Jordan"],"K":["Colombia","DR Congo","Portugal","Uzbekistan"],"L":["Croatia","England","Ghana","Panama"]}
# group standings already locked in from the 46 games played by 2026-06-23: [points, goal-diff, goals-for]
PLAYED = {"Czech Republic":[1,-1,2],"Mexico":[6,3,3],"South Africa":[1,-2,1],"South Korea":[3,0,2],"Bosnia & Herzegovina":[1,-3,2],"Canada":[4,6,7],"Qatar":[1,-6,1],"Switzerland":[4,3,5],"Brazil":[4,3,4],"Haiti":[0,-4,0],"Morocco":[4,1,2],"Scotland":[3,0,1],"Australia":[3,0,2],"Paraguay":[3,-2,2],"Turkey":[0,-3,0],"USA":[6,5,6],"Curaçao":[1,-6,1],"Ecuador":[1,-1,0],"Germany":[6,7,9],"Ivory Coast":[3,0,2],"Japan":[4,4,6],"Netherlands":[4,4,7],"Sweden":[3,0,6],"Tunisia":[0,-8,1],"Belgium":[2,0,1],"Egypt":[4,2,4],"Iran":[2,0,2],"New Zealand":[1,-2,3],"Cape Verde":[2,0,2],"Saudi Arabia":[1,-4,1],"Spain":[4,4,4],"Uruguay":[2,0,3],"France":[6,5,6],"Iraq":[0,-6,1],"Norway":[6,4,7],"Senegal":[0,-3,3],"Algeria":[3,-2,2],"Argentina":[6,5,5],"Austria":[3,0,3],"Jordan":[0,-3,2],"Colombia":[6,3,4],"DR Congo":[1,-1,1],"Portugal":[4,5,6],"Uzbekistan":[0,-7,1],"Croatia":[0,-2,2],"England":[3,2,4],"Ghana":[3,1,1],"Panama":[0,-1,0]}
# the 26 remaining group games (home, away)
SCHED = [["England","Ghana"],["Panama","Croatia"],["Scotland","Brazil"],["Morocco","Haiti"],["Switzerland","Canada"],["Bosnia & Herzegovina","Qatar"],["Czech Republic","Mexico"],["South Africa","South Korea"],["Curaçao","Ivory Coast"],["Ecuador","Germany"],["Japan","Sweden"],["Tunisia","Netherlands"],["Turkey","USA"],["Paraguay","Australia"],["Norway","France"],["Senegal","Iraq"],["Egypt","Iran"],["New Zealand","Belgium"],["Cape Verde","Saudi Arabia"],["Uruguay","Spain"],["Panama","England"],["Croatia","Ghana"],["Algeria","Austria"],["Jordan","Argentina"],["Colombia","Portugal"],["DR Congo","Uzbekistan"]]
# Round-of-32 slots (match 73..88): "1X"=winner of group X, "2X"=runner-up, "3rd"=a best-third slot
R32 = {73:["2A","2B"],74:["1E","3rd"],75:["1F","2C"],76:["1C","2F"],77:["1I","3rd"],78:["2E","2I"],79:["1A","3rd"],80:["1L","3rd"],81:["1D","3rd"],82:["1G","3rd"],83:["2K","2L"],84:["1H","2J"],85:["1B","3rd"],86:["1J","2H"],87:["1K","3rd"],88:["2D","2G"]}
# knockout bracket: match -> (home source, away source); each source = (feeding match, "winner"/"loser")
TREE = {89:[[74,"winner"],[77,"winner"]],90:[[73,"winner"],[75,"winner"]],91:[[76,"winner"],[78,"winner"]],92:[[79,"winner"],[80,"winner"]],93:[[83,"winner"],[84,"winner"]],94:[[81,"winner"],[82,"winner"]],95:[[86,"winner"],[88,"winner"]],96:[[85,"winner"],[87,"winner"]],97:[[89,"winner"],[90,"winner"]],98:[[93,"winner"],[94,"winner"]],99:[[91,"winner"],[92,"winner"]],100:[[95,"winner"],[96,"winner"]],101:[[97,"winner"],[98,"winner"]],102:[[99,"winner"],[100,"winner"]],103:[[101,"loser"],[102,"loser"]],104:[[101,"winner"],[102,"winner"]]}
HOST_RIDX = [m - 73 for m in [74,77,79,80,81,82,85,87]]   # the 8 R32 slots filled by a best-third team

TEAMS = list(ELO.keys()); NT = len(TEAMS); TIDX = {t: i for i, t in enumerate(TEAMS)}
ELO_ARR = np.array([ELO[t] for t in TEAMS], float)
GL = sorted(GROUPS); GIDX = {g: i for i, g in enumerate(GL)}
A, B, MU = PARAMS["a"], PARAMS["b"], PARAMS["mu"]
N, SEED = 10000, 20260618
rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)


def lambdas(eh, ea):                                  # Elo diff -> expected goals (neutral venue)
    sup = A + B * (eh - ea)
    return np.clip((MU + sup) / 2, 0.05, None), np.clip((MU - sup) / 2, 0.05, None)


def grid(lh, la, mx=10):                              # Poisson x Poisson -> P(win), P(draw), P(loss)
    lh, la = np.asarray(lh, float), np.asarray(la, float)
    k = np.arange(mx + 1); lf = np.array([math.lgamma(i + 1) for i in k])
    ph = np.exp(-lh[:, None] + k * np.log(lh[:, None]) - lf)
    pa = np.exp(-la[:, None] + k * np.log(la[:, None]) - lf)
    cum = np.cumsum(pa, 1); below = np.concatenate([np.zeros((len(lh), 1)), cum[:, :-1]], 1)
    pH = (ph * below).sum(1); pD = (ph * pa).sum(1); pA = (ph * np.clip(1 - cum, 0, None)).sum(1)
    s = pH + pD + pA; return pH / s, pD / s, pA / s


def adv(eh, ea):                                      # knockout: win in 90' + draw * Elo win-expectancy (ET/pens)
    pH, pD, _ = grid(*lambdas(eh, ea))
    return pH + pD / (1 + 10.0 ** (-(eh - ea) / 400))


# ---- group stage ----
pts = np.zeros((N, NT)); gd = np.zeros((N, NT)); gf = np.zeros((N, NT))
for t, (p, d, f) in PLAYED.items():
    i = TIDX[t]; pts[:, i] = p; gd[:, i] = d; gf[:, i] = f
for h, a in SCHED:
    hi, ai = TIDX[h], TIDX[a]; lh, la = lambdas(ELO_ARR[hi], ELO_ARR[ai])
    hg = rng.poisson(float(lh), N); ag = rng.poisson(float(la), N)
    gf[:, hi] += hg; gf[:, ai] += ag; gd[:, hi] += hg - ag; gd[:, ai] += ag - hg
    hw, dr = hg > ag, hg == ag
    pts[:, hi] += np.where(hw, 3, np.where(dr, 1, 0)); pts[:, ai] += np.where(~hw & ~dr, 3, np.where(dr, 1, 0))

# rank each group by points, goal-diff, goals-for, then a tiny random tiebreak
ar = np.arange(N); win = {}; run = {}
thirds = np.zeros((N, 12), np.int64); tkey = np.zeros((N, 12))
for g in GL:
    gt = np.array([TIDX[t] for t in GROUPS[g]])
    key = pts[ar[:, None], gt] * 1e4 + (gd[ar[:, None], gt] + 100) * 100 + gf[ar[:, None], gt] + rng.random((N, 4)) * .5
    fin = gt[np.argsort(-key, 1)]; gi = GIDX[g]
    win[g] = fin[:, 0]; run[g] = fin[:, 1]; thirds[:, gi] = fin[:, 2]
    tkey[:, gi] = pts[ar, fin[:, 2]] * 1e4 + (gd[ar, fin[:, 2]] + 100) * 100 + gf[ar, fin[:, 2]] + rng.random(N) * .5

# best 8 of the 12 third-placed teams advance. (Simplification: seed them into the 8 host
# slots by group order, rather than via FIFA Annex C's exact 495-row map — see note.)
top8 = np.sort(np.argsort(-tkey, 1)[:, :8], 1)
third_team = np.zeros((N, 16), np.int64)
for slot, ridx in enumerate(sorted(HOST_RIDX)):
    third_team[:, ridx] = thirds[ar, top8[:, slot]]

# ---- assemble Round of 32 + play the bracket ----
def resolve(c): return win[c[1]] if c[0] == "1" else run[c[1]]
W = np.zeros((N, 105), np.int64); L = np.zeros((N, 105), np.int64)
for mid in range(73, 89):
    r = mid - 73; hc, ac = R32[mid]
    h = resolve(hc); a = third_team[:, r] if ac == "3rd" else resolve(ac)
    u = rng.random(N) < adv(ELO_ARR[h], ELO_ARR[a]); W[:, mid] = np.where(u, h, a); L[:, mid] = np.where(u, a, h)
for mid in range(89, 105):
    (hf, ht), (af, at) = TREE[mid]
    h = W[:, hf] if ht == "winner" else L[:, hf]; a = W[:, af] if at == "winner" else L[:, af]
    u = rng.random(N) < adv(ELO_ARR[h], ELO_ARR[a]); W[:, mid] = np.where(u, h, a); L[:, mid] = np.where(u, a, h)

# ---- champion probabilities ----
champ = np.bincount(np.asarray(W[:, 104], dtype=np.intp), minlength=NT) / N
order = np.argsort(-champ)
print(f"2026 World Cup champion odds (reduced Monte-Carlo, N={N:,}, seed={SEED})")
print(f"{'team':14}{'champ':>8}")
for i in order[:6]:
    print(f"{TEAMS[i]:14}{champ[i]*100:7.1f}%")
print(f"sum over 48 teams = {champ.sum():.3f}")
ana_01.expected_stdout:
2026 World Cup champion odds (reduced Monte-Carlo, N=10,000, seed=20260618)
team             champ
Argentina        30.4%
Spain            22.3%
France           13.0%
England           7.9%
Colombia          5.9%
Portugal          3.5%
sum over 48 teams = 1.000
ana_01.note: Reduced N=10,000 in-browser -> within Monte-Carlo noise of the published N=100,000 (Argentina 30.3%, Spain 22.1%, France 13.7%); graded approximately, not a hard PASS. Best-third seeding is simplified: the 8 qualifying third-placed teams are slotted into the 8 host R32 matches by group order, instead of FIFA Annex C's exact 495-combination map; this does not move the champion top-6 beyond sampling noise.
ana_01.full_ref: code/simulate.py (N=100,000, seed 20260618, Elo cutoff 2026-06-24) reproduces forecast_outputs/champion_odds.csv exactly; the notebook cell cell_simulate (verify/worldcup_forecast.ipynb) runs the full-data version.

import pandas as pd
# Inlined from champion_odds.csv: the 13 teams with >=1% title chance.
# model_rank = rank of p_champion (1 = best); rank_gap = FIFA# - model# (positive = model likes it MORE).
df = pd.DataFrame(
    [["Norway",31,10,21,1.8],["Colombia",13,5,8,5.7],["Japan",18,12,6,1.2],
     ["Germany",10,8,2,2.4],["Mexico",14,13,1,1.1],["Argentina",1,1,0,30.3],
     ["Spain",2,2,0,22.1],["France",3,3,0,13.7],["England",4,4,0,8.4],
     ["Brazil",6,7,-1,3.3],["Netherlands",8,9,-1,2.1],["Portugal",5,6,-1,3.6],
     ["Morocco",7,11,-4,1.4]],
    columns=["team","fifa_rank","model_rank","rank_gap","p_champion_pct"])

liked = df.sort_values("rank_gap", ascending=False).head(5)
faded = df[df["rank_gap"] < 0].sort_values("rank_gap")   # model rates LOWER than FIFA
print("Among the 13 teams with >=1% title chance - model rates HIGHER than FIFA rank (gap = FIFA# - model#):")
for _, r in liked.iterrows():
    print(f"  {r.team:14} FIFA#{r.fifa_rank:>2} -> model#{r.model_rank:>2}  (+{r.rank_gap})  champ {r.p_champion_pct}%")
print("Model rates LOWER than FIFA rank:")
for _, r in faded.iterrows():
    print(f"  {r.team:14} FIFA#{r.fifa_rank:>2} -> model#{r.model_rank:>2}  ({r.rank_gap})  champ {r.p_champion_pct}%")
for nm in ["Colombia","Norway","Portugal"]:
    r = df[df.team == nm].iloc[0]
    tag = " (5th)" if nm == "Colombia" else ""
    print(f"{nm}: FIFA #{r.fifa_rank}, model #{r.model_rank}, champ {r.p_champion_pct}%{tag}")

import pandas as pd
# Inlined from advance_probs.csv: squad market value (EUR m) and the raw reach-semifinal
# probability (the exact CSV fraction). EUR-per-SF-point = value / (p_reach_sf * 100).
# Rows = every team with p_reach_sf > 0.02 (the contender filter story_findings.py uses).
df = pd.DataFrame(
    [["France",1520.0,0.4517],["England",1360.0,0.3736],["Spain",1220.0,0.5432],
     ["Portugal",1010.0,0.1976],["Germany",947.0,0.1698],["Brazil",928.2,0.1917],
     ["Argentina",807.5,0.6671],["Netherlands",754.2,0.149],["Norway",589.9,0.1655],
     ["Belgium",547.5,0.033],["Morocco",447.7,0.1176],["Croatia",387.3,0.0338],
     ["USA",385.6,0.0966],["Uruguay",359.3,0.023],["Switzerland",332.5,0.0593],
     ["Colombia",302.35,0.2412],["Japan",270.85,0.1072],["Algeria",256.9,0.0232],
     ["Austria",245.2,0.0282],["Canada",198.65,0.0271],["Mexico",191.85,0.1156],
     ["South Korea",139.05,0.0339],["Egypt",116.48,0.0243],["Australia",77.45,0.023],
     ["Iran",32.05,0.0208]],
    columns=["team","squad_value_eur_m","p_reach_sf"])
df["p_reach_sf_pct"] = df.p_reach_sf * 100
df["eur_per_sf_point"] = df.squad_value_eur_m / df.p_reach_sf_pct

print("Costliest squads and what the model gives them (reach-SF %):")
for _, r in df.sort_values("squad_value_eur_m", ascending=False).head(5).iterrows():
    print(f"  {r.team:14} EUR {r.squad_value_eur_m:6.1f}m  SF {r.p_reach_sf_pct:5.1f}%  = EUR {r.eur_per_sf_point:6.1f}m per SF-point")
print("Best value (lowest EUR per SF-point), among real contenders:")
for _, r in df.sort_values("eur_per_sf_point").head(3).iterrows():
    print(f"  {r.team:14} EUR {r.squad_value_eur_m:6.1f}m  SF {r.p_reach_sf_pct:5.1f}%  = EUR {r.eur_per_sf_point:6.1f}m per SF-point")
fr = df[df.team == "France"].iloc[0]; co = df[df.team == "Colombia"].iloc[0]
print(f"Colombia squad is {fr.squad_value_eur_m / co.squad_value_eur_m:.1f}x cheaper than France's "
      f"yet within {abs(fr.p_reach_sf_pct - co.p_reach_sf_pct):.1f}pp of its SF chance")

import pandas as pd
# Inlined from advance_probs.csv: reach-Round-of-32 prob = auto top-2 path + best-third path.
df = pd.DataFrame(
    [["Argentina","J",100.0,100.0,0.0],["Spain","H",100.0,95.4,4.6],
     ["France","I",100.0,100.0,0.0],["Brazil","C",100.0,86.3,13.7],
     ["Netherlands","F",100.0,99.8,0.2],["Germany","E",100.0,100.0,0.0],

     ["DR Congo","K",41.4,0.5,40.8]],
    columns=["team","group","p_reach_r32_pct","p_top2_pct","p_best_third_pct"])

    print(f"  {r.team:14} grp {r.group}  R32 {r.p_reach_r32_pct:5.1f}%  "
          f"(top2 {r.p_top2_pct:.0f}% + 3rd-path {r.p_best_third_pct:.0f}%)")

import pandas as pd
# Inlined from forecast_summary.json model_health: model vs naive base-rate baseline on two

df = pd.DataFrame(

import collections
# The 22 men's World Cups 1930-2022 (historical_wc_summary.csv): (year, champion-label, host).
# Self-contained: the champion + host columns are inlined verbatim; everything below is recomputed.
WC = [
    [1930,"Uruguay","Uruguay"],[1934,"Italy","Italy"],[1938,"Italy","France"],
    [1950,"Uruguay","Brazil"],[1954,"West Germany","Switzerland"],[1958,"Brazil","Sweden"],
    [1962,"Brazil","Chile"],[1966,"England","England"],[1970,"Brazil","Mexico"],
    [1974,"West Germany","West Germany"],[1978,"Argentina","Argentina"],[1982,"Italy","Spain"],
    [1986,"Argentina","Mexico"],[1990,"West Germany","Italy"],[1994,"Brazil","United States"],
    [1998,"France","France"],[2002,"Brazil","South Korea/Japan"],[2006,"Italy","Germany"],
    [2010,"Spain","South Africa"],[2014,"Germany","Brazil"],[2018,"France","Russia"],
    [2022,"Argentina","Qatar"],
]
ALIAS = {"West Germany": "Germany"}   # same nation; merge is an explicit editorial call
n = len(WC)
labels = [r[1] for r in WC]
label_counts = collections.Counter(labels)
nation_counts = collections.Counter(ALIAS.get(c, c) for c in labels)
top3 = nation_counts.most_common(3)
top3_titles = sum(v for _, v in top3)
repeat = {k: v for k, v in nation_counts.items() if v >= 2}
repeat_titles = sum(repeat.values())
host_wins = [r for r in WC if r[2] == r[1]]

print(f"Men's World Cups in table: {n} ({WC[0][0]}-{WC[-1][0]})")
print(f"Distinct champion LABELS: {len(label_counts)}  ->  merged NATIONS: {len(nation_counts)} (West Germany = Germany)")
print(f"Top-3 nations hold {top3_titles}/{n} = {100*top3_titles/n:.1f}% of titles: {[(k,v) for k,v in top3]}")
print(f"Repeat champions (>=2): {len(repeat)} nations hold {repeat_titles}/{n} = {100*repeat_titles/n:.1f}%")
print(f"Host-nation wins: {len(host_wins)}/{n} = {100*len(host_wins)/n:.1f}%")
print(f"Model's Argentina 30.3% vs cited ~23% favourite hit-rate -> +{30.3-23:.1f} pp above the long-run favourite")

ana_shootouts.code:
import math
# Penalty-shootout predictability (678 international shootouts 1967-2026; shootouts.csv).
# The leak-free pre-match-Elo favourite for each shootout is computed by build_shootouts.py
# (the full job; see full_ref). Here each cut's (won, n) count + its regulation-win expectation
# are inlined; the cell recomputes the win %, a 95% Wilson CI and a two-sided binomial p-value
# vs a 50/50 coin flip using the stdlib only (no scipy).
def wilson_ci(k, nn, z=1.959963984540054):
    if nn == 0: return (0.0, 0.0)
    p = k / nn
    d = 1 + z*z/nn
    c = (p + z*z/(2*nn)) / d
    h = (z * math.sqrt(p*(1-p)/nn + z*z/(4*nn*nn))) / d
    return (100*(c-h), 100*(c+h))
def binom_two_sided_p(k, nn, p=0.5):
    from math import comb
    def pmf(i): return comb(nn, i) * p**i * (1-p)**(nn-i)
    obs = pmf(k)
    return min(1.0, sum(pmf(i) for i in range(nn+1) if pmf(i) <= obs + 1e-12))

# favourite (higher pre-match Elo) wins, by minimum Elo gap: (gap_label, won, n, expected_regulation_pct)
fav_by_gap = [("any (>=0)", 364, 678, 65.8), (">=25", 306, 565, 68.4),
              (">=50", 252, 473, 70.7), (">=100", 169, 321, 75.0), (">=150", 112, 201, 79.1)]
first_shooter = (136, 256)     # team taking the first kick wins
wc_first = (17, 35)            # World Cup finals subset

print("Favourite (higher pre-match Elo) wins the shootout, by Elo gap:")
for lab, k, nn, exp in fav_by_gap:
    lo, hi = wilson_ci(k, nn)
    print(f"  gap {lab:9} n={nn:>3}  fav wins {100*k/nn:4.1f}% (95% CI {lo:.1f}-{hi:.1f})  vs {exp:.1f}% expected in regulation")
k, nn = fav_by_gap[0][1], fav_by_gap[0][2]
print(f"Headline: across {nn} shootouts the better team won {100*k/nn:.1f}% "
      f"(two-sided binomial p={binom_two_sided_p(k, nn):.3f} vs 50%) - barely above a coin flip.")
fk, fn = first_shooter
print(f"First shooter wins {100*fk/fn:.1f}% of {fn} shootouts with a recorded first kicker.")
wk, wn = wc_first
print(f"At the World Cup finals, the first shooter has won just {wk} of {wn} ({100*wk/wn:.1f}%).")

  gap >=25      n=565  fav wins 54.2% (95% CI 50.0-58.2)  vs 68.4% expected in regulation
  gap >=50      n=473  fav wins 53.3% (95% CI 48.8-57.7)  vs 70.7% expected in regulation
  gap >=100     n=321  fav wins 52.6% (95% CI 47.2-58.0)  vs 75.0% expected in regulation
  gap >=150     n=201  fav wins 55.7% (95% CI 48.8-62.4)  vs 79.1% expected in regulation
